annotations.title: Market profile for an area and bedroom cohort

description: One market profile: an area × residential bedroom cohort with every published measure — asking sale price and rent, completed sale price, gross yield on asking, live stock, new listings, price reductions, turnover and registry sale volume — each with its `basis` sentence, unit, coverage and an observed monthly series sliced to `window` months (default 60); plus the asking price/rent indexes, the whole-area house price index (labelled so; there is no cohort HPI), agent concentration and days to completion, and SearchQuery links to the related completed sales and listings. A measure the source does not publish for the cohort is null with the reason, never zero. Ids come from `search_entities` with entity `market_profiles`. Free.
name: market_profile
title: Market profile for an area and bedroom cohort
